verdicts.note: The PostgreSQL 18 non-durability page lists a RAM-disk data directory, fsync off, synchronous_commit off and full_page_writes off. The fact is confirmed; see recommendation_issues for the clash with S06-F05 and the PostgreSQL 18 image data path.

evidence.quote: Turn off fsync; there is no need to flush data to disk.

recommendation_issues.problem: Its CI half does not work together with S06-F05. GitHub Actions service containers accept no command or arguments (actions/runner#2139, open since 2022-09-19), so 'postgres -c fsync=off' cannot be passed. If both are accepted, a CI step sets fsync and full_page_writes with ALTER SYSTEM plus pg_reload_conf(). Both parameters can only be set in postgresql.conf or on the command line, so a reload applies them, and synchronous_commit can change at any time. The alternative is to start PostgreSQL with a docker run step. For a RAM data directory, note that the PostgreSQL 18 image moved PGDATA to /var/lib/postgresql/18/docker and its VOLUME to /var/lib/postgresql, so a tmpfs on /var/lib/postgresql/data would not catch the data.

A hand-kept list of pg-boss internal tables ties the test harness to the internals of a library that changes quickly (12.33.5 on 2026-09-22 to 12.36.0 on 2026-10-02), and the given list is already incomplete (11 tables). Use pg-boss's public deleteAllJobs() for the per-scenario reset. Scenarios for the nightly classification should trigger the job directly and check the registered schedule (getSchedules(), tz Europe/Istanbul) instead of waiting on pg-boss's cron loop, whose timestamps live on the version row.

'Test ayarında hız sınırları açık olur' needs one more piece. In test mode, Better Auth resolves every inject request to 127.0.0.1. The default rules allow 3 /sign-in* calls per 10 s and 3 code sends per 60 s, measured in real time (Date.now()), so a scenario that signs in four teachers gets a 429. Each simulated user needs its own client address (inject remoteAddress, passed on to Better Auth as in the miss on line 641).

A fast-check model test of the sync endpoint written in Vitest under apps/server would need a second database harness (template, worker clones, cleanup) next to Cucumber's. Run it as one Cucumber scenario whose step calls fc.assert with an explicit numRuns, so only one harness exists.

Putting the phone-only send queue in the shared package mixes phone code into packages/core, which the plan reserves for rules shared by phone, server and panel. A pure TypeScript folder inside apps/mobile with no React Native imports, run by the same Vitest, is just as testable and does not widen the shared package.

The default special rules allow 3 /sign-in* requests per 10 s and 3 /email-otp/send-verification-otp per 60 s. If production has no trusted client-IP header (the plan's Docker Compose list names no reverse proxy), all teachers share one 3-codes-per-minute limit, and no scenario in the plan can detect it.

verdict_reason: Both high-severity findings hold against primary sources. S06-F01: issue #6210 and PR #6214 are open, vitest-runner 10.0.0 is still the latest release with peer vitest >=2.0.0, the Vitest runner always filters per test, and Stryker's break threshold is null by default. S06-F12: the plan has no phone-side test anywhere, and Expo documents only Jest. Three findings are corrected, none of them high: S06-F06 (TRUNCATE waits only on open transactions; Better Auth uses a 127.0.0.1 fallback in test mode and real-time windows), S06-F07 (pg-boss has 11 tables, deleteAllJobs() exists, and the version row carries cron timestamps that leak fake time between scenarios), S06-F09 (Schemathesis has an official Action and declarative login, so the cost was overstated). The other 13 findings are confirmed. One checked_ok date is wrong (light-my-request 6.6.0 is from 2025-02-17). The misses are medium or low: the expanded Turkish Gherkin keywords at line start, Better Auth's client-IP fallback hidden by test mode, per-IP limits versus NAT in the load test, no authorization scenarios, dependency-cruiser missing from the CI line, a merge gate GitHub cannot enforce on a free private repo, and scheduled jobs that can be dropped or auto-disabled. No high-severity miss remains.
